description: Compact and efficient. Well-lit throughout. Deep — views through multiple spaces. No internal corridor — fully open layout. Kitchen: L-shaped or U-shaped, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. Two cooks can work simultaneously on separate counter runs. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: split seating-kitchen-dining, kitchen on side wall. Seating: Sofa in lower-left of living area facing the TV wall; dining table with 4 chairs to the lower-left near windows. Dining table (4 seats). TV on wall right of entry. Cook cannot see TV from cooking position. Diners do not face the TV. Entry: direct into living, first thing visible on arrival is living area. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Double bedroom — accessed via through living, no walk-in wardrobe. Master bedroom is only accessible through the living room — no direct corridor access, least private position. Double bedroom at the rear — maximum distance from entry, best acoustic separation from living activity. Storage: no wardrobe — very limited storage. Sanitary rooms: bathroom (shower and toilet); separate WC. Bathroom accessed directly from the living area — no private corridor. One bathroom plus separate WC — one person can shower while another uses the toilet. Simultaneous showering not possible. Suits: singles or couples. Not suitable for: families with children (only one bedroom); households needing significant storage (no wardrobe noted); remote workers needing a dedicated office (no desk space); roommates seeking separate private bedrooms.
not_suitable_for: households needing significant storage (no wardrobe noted)
